mapper.sql: id, code, name, name_i18n, icon, sort_no, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted

sql.where: deleted = 0 AND code like concat('%', #{code}, '%') AND name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') AND status = #{status}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_product WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM sys_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM sys_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0'
AND code IN #{code}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, code ASC
SELECT FROM sys_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = '0' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, code ASC

SELECT FROM sys_product
ORDER BY sort_no ASC, code ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
